title: SellerConfig
description: One seller of record's bidding setup. agents/sellers/factory.py adds the checks a schema cannot express (floor at or below price, floor present for every offered condition, http(s) URLs with a host).

id.description: Lowercase slug; also the agent seed name and the config file name

port.description: Optional; the kit picks the next free port from 8016 when absent

shipping.description: Flat shipping added to the bid total (default 0)

mode.description: fixed_margin: price = cost x (1 + margin_pct/100), listings carry cost. discount: price = list price x (1 - discount), listings carry price.

discount.description: Fraction off list price, 0.03 means 3 percent

listings.description: Keyed by canonical sku_spec (lowercase, for example "rtx 5070 ti")

condition.description: What the seller says it is offering (primary line)

page_condition.description: What the listing page itself shows; defaults to condition

floor_by_condition.description: Lowest unit price the agent will ever bid, per condition it offers

attrs.description: Spec facts the fit checker reads (category, chipset, length_mm, wattage ...)

alt_lines.description: Further condition lines of the same SKU, bid as alternatives inside the same sealed bid
